title: Boardroom Alpha
description: Intimate boardroom with built-in projector, whiteboard, and video conferencing equipment. Seats up to 16 in a U-shape or boardroom layout. Natural daylight and blackout blinds.

title: Grand Ballroom Meridian
description: Grand ballroom with stage, ceiling-mounted screens, and professional sound system. Accommodates up to 180 guests for seated dinner or 250 standing. Crystal chandeliers and adjustable lighting.

title: Garden Terrace
description: Open-air terrace with panoramic garden views, suitable for ceremonies and receptions. Accommodates up to 80 guests. Retractable canopy for weather protection. Fairy light canopy available.

title: Conference Room A
description: Medium-sized conference room with modular furniture. Capacity 50 in theatre style, 30 in classroom setup. Built-in screen and HDMI connections.

title: Workshop Room East
description: Flexible workshop space for up to 30 participants with movable furniture and writable walls. Adjacent to main conference wing.

title: Workshop Room West
description: Flexible workshop space for up to 30 participants. Mirrors East wing layout. Breakout-friendly with independent climate control.

title: Private Dining Room
description: Elegant private dining room for intimate gatherings. Seats up to 24 guests around a single table. Dedicated service entrance and wine display.

title: Executive Lunch Buffet
description: Three-course buffet lunch with seasonal menu. Includes starter bar, hot and cold mains, and dessert station. Serves up to 150 guests. Dietary labels for all items.

title: Coffee & Refreshments Service
description: Continuous coffee, tea, juices, and pastries throughout your event. Set up in dedicated break area. Serves up to 200 guests.

title: Gala Dinner Package
description: Four-course seated dinner with amuse-bouche, sommelier wine pairing, and dedicated wait staff. Serves up to 150 guests. Customisable menu available.

title: Cocktail Reception Package
description: Premium cocktail reception with canapés, signature drinks, and bartender service. Suitable for up to 200 guests standing.

title: Brunch Buffet
description: Relaxed brunch buffet with eggs station, pastries, fresh fruit, and cold cuts. Serves up to 100 guests. Perfect for morning-after events.

title: Standard Room Block
description: Block of standard hotel rooms. Comfortable rooms with ensuite bathroom, desk, and complimentary WiFi. Available up to 40 rooms per booking.

title: Superior Room Block
description: Block of superior rooms with upgraded amenities, city views, and minibar. Available up to 20 rooms per booking.

title: Bridal Suite
description: Luxurious bridal suite with separate living area, champagne welcome, late checkout, and in-room breakfast. One suite available.

title: Basic Projector & Screen Kit
description: HD projector with motorised screen, HDMI adapter, laser pointer, and clicker. Suitable for rooms up to 50 people.

title: Premium AV Suite
description: Full audio-visual package with multi-screen setup, professional sound system, live streaming capability, and dedicated sound engineer.

title: Spa Day Package — Bridal Party
description: Half-day spa experience for groups up to 8. Includes massage, facial, access to thermal pools, and champagne. Perfect for bridal parties.

title: Guided City Tour
description: Three-hour guided walking tour of the city for groups up to 25. Includes museum entry and local coffee stop.

title: Standard Floral Arrangement
description: Table centrepieces and entrance arrangements using seasonal flowers. Covers up to 15 tables plus entrance and registration area.

title: Premium Floral & Decor Package
description: Full venue decoration including ceremony arch, aisle arrangements, table centrepieces, and hanging installations. Bespoke design consultation included.

title: DJ Entertainment Package
description: Professional DJ with sound system, lighting rig, and microphone for speeches. Up to 5 hours of entertainment. Music planning consultation included.

title: Live Band — String Quartet
description: Professional string quartet for ceremonies and cocktail hours. Up to 3 hours of live classical and contemporary music.

title: Live Band — Full Band
description: Five-piece live band with vocalist. Covers pop, rock, soul, and jazz. Includes sound equipment and lighting. Up to 4 hours.

title: High-Speed Event WiFi
description: Dedicated high-speed wireless network for your event. Supports up to 500 concurrent devices with branded login page.

title: Registration Desk & Staff
description: Professional registration team with branded badges, tablet check-in system, and welcome desk setup. Includes two staff members for up to 8 hours.

title: Valet Parking Service
description: Professional valet parking for up to 80 vehicles. Includes signage, ticket system, and uniformed attendants.

title: Vegetarian Menu Upgrade
description: Full vegetarian alternative menu for any catering package. Includes dedicated prep area to avoid cross-contamination. Per person supplement.

title: Special Dietary Accommodation
description: Custom dietary accommodation for gluten-free, vegan, halal, or kosher requirements. Chef consultation and dedicated preparation. Per person supplement.
